verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a pricing page exists and describes plan tiers/features (mail scanning, forwarding, storage) and mentions check deposit is 'pay per deposit' and utility add-ons cost 'an additional fee', but no actual dollar amounts, monthly prices, scan allowances, or specific per-item fees are given anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: actual monthly price figures, numeric scan allowance thresholds, and concrete per-item fee amounts for extra scans, forwarding, storage, and check deposit.
